name: GCP — IAM Privilege Escalation via SetIamPolicy
xql_query:
datamodel dataset = google_cloud_logging_raw
| filter xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "SetIamPolicy" or xdm.event.operation_sub_type contains "setIamPolicy"
| filter xdm.event.description contains "roles/owner" or xdm.event.description contains "roles/editor" or xdm.event.description contains "roles/iam.serviceAccountUser" or xdm.event.description contains "roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator"
| bin _time span = 1h
| comp count() as priv_grants,
       values(xdm.source.user.username) as users,
       values(xdm.event.type) as operations,
       values(xdm.event.description) as events_seen
       by xdm.source.ipv4, _time
| fields xdm.source.ipv4, users, events_seen
description: GCP SetIamPolicy or setIamPolicy method assigning roles/owner, roles/editor, roles/iam.serviceAccountUser, or roles/iam.serviceAccountTokenCreator.
alert_name: GCP — IAM Privilege Escalation via SetIamPolicy

TA0004 - Privilege Escalation: T1098.003 - Account Manipulation: Additional Cloud Roles
